name: Joint Base Andrews
description: Joint Base Andrews hosts the 316th Wing and provides priority airlift support for the President, Vice President, and senior leaders. Home of Air Force One.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. Visitor Control Center processes day passes.

gates.name: Main Gate (Allentown Rd)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate off I-495 / Beltway. Visitor processing available nearby.
gates.address: Allentown Rd at Main Gate, Joint Base Andrews, MD 20762

gates.name: Virginia Gate (South)
gates.notes: Serves traffic from Northern Virginia via I-495 South. Closed after 2100.
gates.address: Virginia Gate Rd, Joint Base Andrews, MD 20762

gates.name: Pearl Harbor / Commercial Gate (East)
gates.notes: Commercial and limited personal vehicle access. No 24/7 outbound lane.
gates.address: Pearl Harbor Gate, Joint Base Andrews, MD 20762

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; Sat 0800-1600; Sun & Federal Holidays closed
gates.notes: Day passes, REAL ID processing, and visitor registration. Located at 1832 Robert M. Bond Drive.
gates.address: 1832 Robert M. Bond Drive, Joint Base Andrews, MD 20762

resources.name: Freedom Hall Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Primary DFAC serving balanced meals, fresh produce, and quality proteins. Sunroom available for small group reservations. In-flight kitchen support.
resources.hours: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner daily (exact meal hours posted at facility)
resources.address: 1628 Colorado Ave, Bldg 1628, Joint Base Andrews, MD 20762

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, and family documents. REAL ID required for base access.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Military Housing Office for on-base privatized housing or off-base referrals. Unaccompanied personnel report to Dorm Management.

sections.body: FSS, M&FRC, and official installation sites for in-processing and community support.
